upstream_patch.description: The surviving IODone patch preserves D0 around a call to ROM address $402082. It confirms the original routine entry and the missing preservation in the ROM body.

data_spans.description: Three word offsets from FSIODneTbl to Fetch, Stash and IODone, preserved as symbolic expressions.

boundary_evidence.description: The reference comment identifies DeviceMgr.a at FSIODneTbl, $402030. The preceding trap-dispatch module ends at $40202E. The complete surviving DeviceMgr.a ends with AddDrive, whose final RTS is at $402566. Independent initialization code begins at $402568. Interrupt, cursor and trap-dispatch code separates Queue from Device Manager.

edits.description: Retained the complete manager from FSIODneTbl through AddDrive. Preserved the original header, history through 1985 and applicable comments. Removed later revision tags on restored instructions; retained their comment wording.

Removed the later wrapper that saves and restores D0, and the later StripAddress sequence. The ROM starts IODone with MOVE.L DCtlQHead(A1),D1. PatchPlusROM.a explicitly binds its D0-preserving patch to $402082; DeviceMgr.a records incorporation of that patch on January 13, 1986.

Restored direct bit-7 handle locking and unlocking, recovery of a DCE handle from SysZone and -4(A1), and explicit 24-bit address masking. GoDriver strips the high pointer byte on the stack. Open and MpUnitNum mask pointers with Lo3Bytes. These replace later HLock, HUnlock, RecoverHandle and StripAddress calls.

Removed slot-driver detection, slot resource searches, version comparisons, unit-table growth and extended DCE setup. Retained the installed-driver and named-resource searches. Restored the signed comparison of a driver address with ROMBase and the direct memory flags.

Restored A2-A3 in the manager entry-point register lists. Removed the later GoDriver, WaitUntilDone and SyncWait jump hooks, and the Read/Write idle hooks. Restored Control, Status, KillIO and AddDrive names from before the 1992 Trap suffix change.
Restored DCtlEntrySize to 40. SysEqu.a explicitly records that this field used to be 40 bytes; the later 52-byte layout adds slot fields. The ROM allocates and clears exactly 40 bytes.

Replaced the original literal $A43D instruction with the symbolic _DrvrInstallLock trap declaration. Declared the observed system-heap variants of ResrvMem and NewHandle. Restored the base DisposHandle trap $A023 used by this ROM.
Assigned Enqueue and the four file-system entry addresses from the ROM call operands. Kept the original symbolic call names and made PC-relative operands explicit.

Matched every source branch to the ROM branch sequence and made its width explicit. All branch conditions agree. Retained the three symbolic FSIODneTbl offsets as data; all other bytes are assembled instructions, including symbolic traps.

preserved_rom_behavior.description: IODone allows completion routines and subsequent dispatch work to change D0. The reconstruction does not include the later patch that preserves its input value.
Open uses a signed comparison with ROMBase to distinguish RAM and ROM drivers. It does not apply the later unsigned comparison or StripAddress call.
Close treats only ClosErr as a failed close. Other driver results still lead to clearing the open flag, matching the compatibility behavior recorded in the 1985 history.
DrvrRemove refuses to remove an open driver. It does not call the close routine despite the retained original routine comment saying that it does.

verification.result: All 1336 assembled bytes equal the ROM span. All 63 recorded symbols match their addresses.
verification.method: Translated the final source directly with the shared verifier, assembled for the 68000, linked at the ROM address, checked for unresolved relocations and compared every byte with the ROM.
verification.translator_support: The shared translator qualifies Control and Status code labels to avoid GNU register aliases. The MPW source retains the original names.
limitations: MPW assembly has not been run.
Byte equality does not establish the exact formatting or private-label spelling of the earlier source.
The final verification covers this module only. QuickDraw files were excluded from this work.

prose_lint.result: Zero errors, warnings or suggestions. Preserved historical comments were excluded.
